h: וְאַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר
t: וְאַתְּ תְּפַקֵּד יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִסְּבוּן לָךְ מִשְׁחָא זֵיתָא דַכְיָא כָּתִישָׁא לְאַנְהָרָא
e: You shall command the B’nei Yisrael and have them bring you clear olive oil, [made from olives that were] crushed for lighting,
to keep the lamp burning constantly.

h: בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִח֨וּץ לַפָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָעֵדֻ֗ת יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו מֵעֶ֥רֶב עַד־בֹּ֖קֶר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
t: בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא מִבָּרָא לְפָרֻכְתָּא דִּעַל סַהֲדוּתָא יְסַדַּר יָתֵיהּ אַהֲרֹן וּבְנוֹהִי מֵרַמְשָׁא עַד צַפְרָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the paroches, which is before the Testimony, Aharon and his sons shall arrange it [for the lamp to burn] from evening to morning before Adonoy.
This is an everlasting statute for their generations
of the B’nei Yisrael.

h: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַקְרֵ֣ב אֵלֶיךָ֩ אֶת־אַהֲרֹ֨ן אָחִ֜יךָ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֔וֹ
אַהֲרֹ֕ן נָדָ֧ב וַאֲבִיה֛וּא אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְאִיתָמָ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃
t: וְאַתְּ קָרֵב לְוָתָךְ יָת אַהֲרֹן אָחוּךְ וְיָת בְּנוֹהִי עִמֵּיהּ
אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן:
e: And [now separate] and take unto you your brother, Aharon, and his sons with him,
from among the B’nei Yisrael, to serve [before] Me [as kohanim]:
Aharon, Nadav, Avihu, Elazar, and Isamar, the sons of Aharon.
Make sacred garments for your brother, Aharon,
for honor and splendor.

t: וְאַתְּ תְּמַלֵּל עִם כָּל חַכִּימֵי לִבָּא
וְיַעְבְּדוּן יָת לְבוּשֵׁי אַהֲרֹן לְקַדָּשׁוּתֵיהּ לְשַׁמָּשָׁא קֳדָמַי:
e: Speak to all who are wise in heart,
whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom,
and have them make Aharon’s garments, to sanctify him to serve [before] Me [as kohein].

h: וְאֵ֨לֶּה הַבְּגָדִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשׂ֗וּ חֹ֤שֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד֙ וּמְעִ֔יל
וְעָשׂ֨וּ בִגְדֵי־קֹ֜דֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֛יךָ וּלְבָנָ֖יו לְכַהֲנוֹ־לִֽי׃
t: וְאִלֵּין לְבוּשַׁיָּא דִּי יַעְבְּדוּן חוּשְׁנָא וְאֵפוֹדָא וּמְעִילָא
וְיַעְבְּדוּן לְבוּשֵׁי קוּדְשָׁא לְאַהֲרֹן אָחוּךְ וְלִבְנוֹהִי לְשַׁמָּשָׁא קֳדָמַי:
e: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastplate, an eiphod, a robe,
a checkered undershirt, a turban and a sash-belt.
Have them make sacred garments for your brother Aharon, and for his sons, to serve [before] Me [as kohanim].
They shall take the gold,
the greenish-blue wool, the dark red wool the crimson [colored] wool,
and the fine twined linen.

h: זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן תּוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
t: דַּהֲבָא תִּכְלָא וְאַרְגְּוָנָא צְבַע זְהוֹרִי וּבוּץ שְׁזִיר עוֹבַד אֳמָן:
e: They shall make the eiphod out of gold,
greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool, and fine twined linen, the work of a craftsman.

h: שְׁתֵּ֧י כְתֵפֹ֣ת חֹֽבְרֹ֗ת יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֛וֹ אֶל־שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָ֖יו וְחֻבָּֽר׃
t: תַּרְתֵּין כַּתְפִּין מְלַפְּפָן יְהוֹן לֵיהּ עַל תְּרֵין סִטְרוֹהִי וְיִתְלָפַף:
e: It shall have two shoulder straps attached to it, they shall be attached at its two corners [sides].

h: זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
t: דַּהֲבָא תִּכְלָא וְאַרְגְּוָנָא וּצְבַע זְהוֹרִי וּבוּץ שְׁזִיר:
e: The eiphod’s belt [that enhances it], which is on it,
shall be made in the same manner [as the eiphod] — it shall be woven with it.
[with] gold, greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool and fine twined linen.
Take two shoham [onyx] stones
and engrave on them
the names of the B’nei Yisrael.

h: וְאֶת־שְׁמ֞וֹת הַשִּׁשָּׁ֧ה הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־הָאֶ֥בֶן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית כְּתוֹלְדֹתָֽם׃
t: וְיָת שְׁמָהַת שִׁתָּא דְאִשְׁתָּאָרוּ עַל אַבְנָא תִנְיֵתָא כְּתוּלְדָתְהוֹן:
e: Six of their names
on the one stone,
and the remaining six names on the second stone, in the order of their birth.

t: כְּתַב מְפָרַשׁ כִּגְלֹּף דְּעִזְקָא תִּגְלוֹף יָת תַּרְתֵּין אַבְנַיָּא
e: The work of a skilled [precious] stone engraver,
like the engraving of a signet [ring] [written in script that is clear like they engrave a signet ring] shall you engrave the two stones
with the names of the B’nei Yisrael.
In gold settings shall you place them.

h: וְשַׂמְתָּ֞ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י הָאֲבָנִ֗ים עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד
וְנָשָׂא֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־שְׁמוֹתָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה עַל־שְׁתֵּ֥י כְתֵפָ֖יו לְזִכָּרֹֽן׃
t: וּתְשַׁוִּי יָת תַּרְתֵּין אַבְנַיָא עַל כִּתְפֵּי אֵפוֹדָא
וְיִטּוֹל אַהֲרֹן יָת שְׁמָהָתְהוֹן קֳדָם יְיָ עַל תְּרֵין כִּתְפּוֹהִי לְדָכְרָנָא:
e: Set the two stones on the shoulder straps of the eiphod
as remembrance stones for the B’nei Yisrael.
Aharon shall bear their names before Adonoy, on his two shoulders as a remembrance.
Make gold settings,

t: וְתִתֵּן יָת תִּכַּיָּא גְדִילָתָא עַל מְרַמְּצָתָא:
e: and two chains of pure gold,
you will make them for the ends, a braided work.
and you will fasten the braided chain’s to the settings.

h: זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
t: דַּהֲבָא תִּכְלָא וְאַרְגְּוָנָא וּצְבַע זְהוֹרִי וּבוּץ שְׁזִיר תַּעְבֵּד יָתֵיהּ:
e: Make a breastplate of judgment, the work of a craftsman.
Make it in the same manner you made the eiphod.
[Out of] gold, greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool and fine twined linen, shall you make it.
It shall be a doubled square,
a span in its length and a span in its width.
Fill it [the breastplate settings] with fillings of [mounted] stones.
Their shall be four rows of [precious] stones:
[The first row:] An odem [ruby], pitda [topaz], and a barekes [emerald],
[shall be placed on] the first row [one].
The second row:
nofech [carbuncle], sapphire, and yahalom [diamond].
The third row:
leshem [opal], shevo [agate], and achlomo [amethyst].
The fourth row:
tarshish [chrysolite], shoham [onyx], and yoshfei [jasper].
[These stones] shall be placed in gold settings in their fullness.

h: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים תִּֽהְיֶ֜יןָ עַל־שְׁמֹ֧ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־שְׁמֹתָ֑ם
t: וְאַבְנַיָּא יְהֶוְיָן עַל שְׁמָהַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּרְתֵּי עֶסְרֵי עַל שְׁמָהַתְהוֹן
כְּתַב מְפָרַשׁ כִּגְלוֹף דְּעִזְקָא גְּבַר עַל שְׁמֵיהּ
e: These stones shall have on them the names of the B’nei Yisrael, twelve of them by their names,
each one’s name [written in script that is clear like they engrave a signet ring] engraved as on a signet [ring],
representing the twelve tribes.

h: וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עַל־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַֽׁרְשֹׁ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת
t: וְתַעְבֵּד עַל חוּשְׁנָא תִּכִּין מְתַחְמָן עוֹבַד גְּדִילוּ
e: Make [two] twisted end-chains for the breastplate, braided work
of pure gold.

t: וְתַעְבֵּד עַל חוּשְׁנָא תַּרְתֵּין עִזְקָן דִּדְהַב
e: Make two gold ring’s for the breastplate,
and set the two rings
on the two [upper] corners [sides] for the breastplate.
Place [attach] the two gold-braided chains
on the two rings,
at the corners [sides] of the breastplate.

t: וְתִתֵּן עַל כִּתְפֵּי אֵפוֹדָא לָקֳבֵל אַפּוֹהִי:
e: The two ends of the two braided chains [which are on its two sides],
you shall place [attach] to the two settings,
and place them on the shoulder straps of the eiphod toward its face.

t: עַל סִפְתֵיהּ דִּי לְעִבְרָא דְאֵפוֹדָא מִלְּגָיו:
e: Make two gold rings
and set them
on the two [lower] corners [sides] of the breastplate,
on its edge that is on the inner side of the eiphod.

h: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֡ם עַל־שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפ֨וֹת הָאֵפ֤וֹד מִלְּמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו
t: וְתִתֵּן יָתְהוֹן עַל תַּרְתֵּין כִּתְפֵּי אֵפוֹדָא מִלְּרַע מִלָּקֳבֵל אַפּוֹהִי
e: Make two gold rings
and place them on the two shoulder straps of the eiphod, on the bottom, toward its face,
a gainst where they are joined,
above the eiphod’s belt.

h: וְיִרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־הַ֠חֹשֶׁן מטבעתו [מִֽטַּבְּעֹתָ֞יו] אֶל־טַבְּעֹ֤ת הָאֵפֹד֙ בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת
t: וְיֶחְדּוּן יָת חוּשְׁנָא מֵעִזְקְתֵיהּ לְעִזְקְתָא דְאֵפוֹדָא בְּחוּטָא דִתְכֶלְתָּא
e: They shall bind the [lower] rings of the breastplate to the [lower] rings of the eiphod with a cord of greenish-blue wool,
so that it [the breastplate] remains against the eiphod’s belt,
so that the breastplate does not move
from the eiphod.

h: וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת־שְׁמ֨וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בְּחֹ֧שֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט עַל־לִבּ֖וֹ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ
t: וְיִטּוֹל אַהֲרֹן יָת שְׁמָהַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחשֶׁן דִּינָא עַל לִבֵּיהּ בְּמֵעֲלֵיהּ לְקוּדְשָׁא
e: Aharon will thus carry the names of the B’nei Yisrael on the breastplate of judgment, over his heart, when he comes into the Holy [sanctuary],
as a constant remembrance before Adonoy.

h: וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת־מִשְׁפַּ֨ט בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל עַל־לִבּ֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃
t: וְתִתֵּן בְּחשֶׁן דִּינָא יָת אוּרַיָּא וְיָת תֻּמַּיָּא
וְיִטּוֹל אַהֲרֹן יָת דִּינָא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל לִבֵּיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא:
e: Place in the breastplate the Urim and Tumim,
and they will be over Aharon’s heart
when he comes before Adonoy.
Aharon will carry the judgment of the B’nei Yisrael over his heart, before Adonoy always.

t: וְתַעְבֵּד יָת מְעִילָא דְאֵפוֹדָא גְּמִיר תִּכְלָא:
e: Make the robe of the eiphod completely out of greenish-blue wool.

h: שָׂפָ֡ה יִֽהְיֶה֩ לְפִ֨יו סָבִ֜יב מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֗ג כְּפִ֥י תַחְרָ֛א יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃
t: תּוֹרָא יְהֵי מַקַּף לְפוּמֵיהּ סְחוֹר סְחוֹר עוֹבַד מָחֵי כְּפוּם שִׁרְיָן יְהֵי לֵיהּ לָא יִתְבְּזָע:
e: Its opening at the top shall be turned inward.
Its opening shall have a border [encircling] all around, [this border shall be] of woven work, like there is around the opening of a coat of armor, so that it will not be torn.

h: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־שׁוּלָ֗יו רִמֹּנֵי֙ תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י
t: וְתַעְבֵּד עַל שִׁיפוֹלוֹהִי רִמּוֹנֵי תִּכְלָא וְאַרְגְּוָנָא וּצְבַע זְהוֹרִי
e: On its [lower] hem you shall make pomegranates of greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, and crimson [colored] wool —
around its [lower] hem.
There shall be gold bells between them, all around.
A gold bell and a pomegranate,
a gold bell and a pomegranate,
on the [lower] hem of the robe all around.

h: וְנִשְׁמַ֣ע ק֠וֹלוֹ בְּבֹא֨וֹ אֶל־הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וּבְצֵאת֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
t: וְיִשְׁתְּמַע קָלֵיהּ בְּמֵעֲלֵיהּ לְקוּדְשָׁא קֳדָם יְיָ וּבְמִפְּקֵיהּ וְלָא יְמוּת:
e: It shall be on Aharon when he performs [Divine] service.
Its sound shall be heard when he comes into the Holy [sanctuary] in the presence of Adonoy, and when he comes out, so that he will not die.
You shall make a diadem of pure gold,
and engrave on it in the manner of a signet [ring] [script that is clear],
“Holy unto Adonoy.”
Set [fasten] it on a greenish-blue wool cord,
so that it will be on the turban.
It shall be near the front of the turban.

h: וְנָשָׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַקְדִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
t: וְיִטּוֹל אַהֲרֹן יָת עֲוָיַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא דִּי יְקַדְּשׁוּן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
e: It shall be [worn] on Aharon’s forehead,
and Aharon will carry [atone] the iniquity of the sacred offerings that the B’nei Yisrael consecrate
for all their sacred gifts.
It shall be on his forehead always
to make them [the sacred-offerings] acceptable before Adonoy.
Make the undershirt with checkered work of fine linen.
Make the turban of fine linen.
and the sash-belt shall be the work of an embroiderer.
For Aharon’s sons, make undershirts,
and [also] make sash-belts for them.
Make turban-like hats for them,
for honor and splendor.

h: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֨ אֹתָ֜ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֧ אֶת־יָדָ֛ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם וְכִהֲנ֥וּ לִֽי׃
t: וּתְרַבֵּי יָתְהוֹן וּתְקָרֵב יָת קֻרְבַּנְהוֹן וּתְקַדֵּשׁ יָתְהוֹן וִישַׁמְּשׁוּן קֳדָמָי:
e: Clothe your brother, Aharon, with [these garments],
and also [clothe] his sons along with him.
[Then] anoint them, and install them [offer their sacrifices], and consecrate them to serve [before] Me [as kohanim].
Make for them linen pants
to cover their nakedness, reaching
from their waists to their thighs.

h: וְהָיוּ֩ עַל־אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְעַל־בָּנָ֜יו בְּבֹאָ֣ם אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ
t: וִיהוֹן עַל אַהֲרֹן וְעַל בְּנוֹהִי בְּמֵעַלְהוֹן לְמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא אוֹ בְמִקְרָבְהוֹן לְמַדְבְּחָא לְשַׁמָּשָׁא בְקוּדְשָׁא
e: These [garments] must be worn by Aharon and his sons whenever they come into Tent of Meeting, or approach the altar to serve in the Holy [sanctuary],
in order that they not bear iniquity and die.
This is an everlasting statute for him and his descendants after him.

h: וְזֶ֨ה הַדָּבָ֜ר אֲשֶֽׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֑י
לְ֠קַח פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֧ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר וְאֵילִ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם תְּמִימִֽם׃
t: וְדֵין פִּתְגָּמָא דִּי תַעְבֵּד לְהוֹן לְקַדָּשָׁא יָתְהוֹן לְשַׁמָּשָׁא קֳדָמָי
סַב תּוֹר חָד בַּר תּוֹרֵי וְדִכְרִין תְּרֵין שַׁלְמִין:
e: This is what you must do for them to consecrate them to serve [before] Me [as kohanim].
Take one young bull and two unblemished rams,

h: וְלֶ֣חֶם מַצּ֗וֹת וְחַלֹּ֤ת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן
t: וּלְחֵם פַּטִּיר וּגְרִיצִין פַּטִּירִין דְּפִילָן בִּמְשַׁח
e: [also] unleavened bread, unleavened loaves mixed with [olive] oil.
and unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
You must make them with fine wheat flour.
Place them in one basket
and bring them in the basket
[along] with the young bull and the two rams.
Bring Aharon and his sons near
to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,
and immerse them in the water.

t: וְתִסַּב יָת לְבוּשַׁיָּא וְתַלְבֵּשׁ יָת אַהֲרֹן יָת כִּתּוּנָא
e: Take the garments and clothe Aharon with the undershirt,
the robe of the eiphod,
the eiphod, the breastplate,
and gird [beautify] him
with the belt of the eiphod.

t: וְתִתֵּן יָת כְּלִילָא דְּקוּדְשָׁא עַל מִצְנֶפְתָּא:
e: Set the turban upon his head
and place the sacred diadem upon the turban.
Take the anointing oil
and pour it on his head
and anoint him.
Bring his sons near
and clothe them with undershirts.

h: וְחָגַרְתָּ֩ אֹתָ֨ם אַבְנֵ֜ט אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ֤ לָהֶם֙ מִגְבָּעֹ֔ת
t: וּתְזָרֵז יָתְהוֹן הֶמְיָנִין אַהֲרֹן וּבְנוֹהִי וְתַתְקַן לְהוֹן כּוֹבָעִין
e: Gird them — Aharon and his sons — with sash-belts, and bind turban-like hats for them,
and the priesthood shall be for them an everlasting statute.
Thus you shall install [offer the sacrifice of] Aharon and [the sacrifice of] his sons.

h: וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּֽר׃
t: וְיִסְמוֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבְנוֹהִי יָת יְדֵיהוֹן עַל רֵישׁ תּוֹרָא:
e: Bring the young bull
before the Tent of Meeting,
and Aharon and his sons shall support their hands on the head of the young bull.
Slaughter the bull before Adonoy,
at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
Take of the blood of the bull
and put it on the horn-like elevations of the altar with your finger,
and pour all the [remaining] blood
at the base of the altar.

t: וְתִסַּב יָת כָּל תַּרְבָּא דְּחָפֵי יָת גַּוָּא
e: Take all the fat that covers the inner organs,
the lobe that is with the liver,
the two kidneys
with the fat that is upon them,
and burn them on the altar.

t: וְיָת בִּסְרָא דְתוֹרָא וְיָת מַשְׁכֵּיהּ וְיָת אוּכְלֵיהּ
e: [However] the flesh of the bull, its skin, and its intestinal waste,
you shall burn with fire
outside the camp.
It is a sin-offering.

h: וְסָ֨מְכ֜וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
t: וְיִסְמְכוּן אַהֲרֹן וּבְנוֹהִי יָת יְדֵיהוֹן עַל רֵישׁ דִּכְרָא:
e: Take the first ram
and have Aharon and his sons support their hands on the head of the ram.
Slaughter the ram,
and take its blood,
and sprinkle it around the altar.
Cut the ram into pieces [its limbs].
[Then] wash off its intestines and its legs
and place them with its cut up pieces [limbs] and its head.
Burn the entire ram on the altar,
it is a burnt-offering to [before] Adonoy,
a pleasing fragrance [to be accepted with favor],
a fire-offering to [sacrifice before] Adonoy.

h: וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
t: וְיִסְמוֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבְנוֹהִי יָת יְדֵיהוֹן עַל רֵישׁ דִּכְרָא:
e: Take the second ram
and have Aharon and his sons support their hands on the head of the ram.

h: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־הָאַ֗יִל וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ מִדָּמוֹ֙ וְנָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל־תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְעַל־תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָיו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית
t: וְתִכּוֹס יָת דִּכְרָא וְתִסַּב מִדְמֵיהּ וְתִתֵּן עַל רוּם אוּדְנָא דְאַהֲרֹן וְעַל רוּם אוּדְנָא דִבְנוֹהִי דְּיַמִּינָא
וְתִזְרוֹק יָת דְּמָא עַל מַדְבְּחָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
e: Slaughter the ram, and take of its blood, and place it on the tip of Aharon’s right ear, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons,
and on the thumb of their right hands,
and on the big toe of their right feet.
Sprinkle the [remaining] blood all around the altar.

h: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן־הַדָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֮ וּמִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֒
t: וְתִסַּב מִן דְּמָא דִּי עַל מַדְבְּחָא וּמִמִּשְׁחָא דִרְבוּתָא
וְעַל בְּנוֹהִי וְעַל לְבוּשֵׁי בְנוֹהִי עִמֵּיהּ
e: Take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil
and sprinkle it upon Aharon and his garments,
and upon his sons and their garments as well.
Thus he and his garments will be consecrated,
along with his sons and his son’s garments.

h: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן־הָ֠אַיִל הַחֵ֨לֶב וְהָֽאַלְיָ֜ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֗רֶב וְאֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַכָּבֵד֙ וְאֵ֣ת שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֗ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן
t: וְתִסַּב מִן דִּכְרָא תַּרְבָּא וְאַלִּיתָא וְיָת תַּרְבָּא דְחָפֵי יָת גַּוָּא וְיָת חֲצַר כַּבְדָּא וְיָת תַּרְתֵּין כָּלְיָן וְיָת תַּרְבָּא דִּי עֲלֵיהֶן
e: Take from the ram the [intestinal] fat, the broad tail, the fat that covers the inner organs, the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them,
and the right shoulder,
for it is a ram of a completion-offering [offering].

h: וְכִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וַֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד
t: וּפִתָּא דִלְחֵם חַד וּגְרִצְתָּא דִלְחֵם מְשַׁח חֲדָא וְאֶסְפּוֹג חַד
e: [Take also] one bread-cake, and one loaf of oiled bread, and one wafer
from the basket of unleavened bread
that is before Adonoy.
Place all [these things]
upon the [open] hands of Aharon,
and upon the [open] hands of his sons,
and you shall wave them for wave-offering before Adonoy.
Then take [these things] from their hands
and burn them on the altar after the burnt-offering
as a pleasing fragrance [to be accepted with favor] before Adonoy.
It is a fire-offering to [sacrifice before] Adonoy.

h: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הֶֽחָזֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֤יל הַמִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן
t: וְתִסַּב יָת חֶדְיָא מִדְּכַר קֻרְבָּנַיָּא דִּי לְאַהֲרֹן
e: Take the breast from Aharon’s installation ram [offering]
and wave it as wave-offering to [before] Adonoy.
Then it shall be your [Moshe’s] portion.

h: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה
t: וּתְקַדֵּשׁ יָת חֶדְיָא דַאֲרָמוּתָא וְיָת שׁוֹקָא דְאַפְרָשׁוּתָא
e: Sanctify the breast of the wave-offering, and the shoulder of the terumah-offering
which were [the] waved and uplifted [parts]
of the ram of the completion-offering [offering]
[which was used to install] Aharon and his sons.

h: וְהָיָה֩ לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּלְבָנָ֜יו לְחָק־עוֹלָ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
וּתְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵאֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִזִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֔ם
t: וִיהֵי לְאַהֲרֹן וְלִבְנוֹהִי לִקְיָם עָלָם מִן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
וְאַפְרָשׁוּתָא יְהֵי מִן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנִּכְסַת קוּדְשֵׁיהוֹן
e: It [the breast and shoulder] shall be for Aharon and his sons’ by statute for ever. [This portion is taken] from the B’nei Yisrael
for it is a terumah-offering.
It shall be a terumah-offering from the B’nei Yisrael taken from their peace-offerings.
It is their terumah-offering to [before] Adonoy.
Aharon’s sacred garments
shall be his son’s after him,
to be uplifted through them
and to be installed [offer their sacrifices] through them.

h: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִלְבָּשָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תַּחְתָּ֖יו מִבָּנָ֑יו
אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֛א אֶל־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֥ת בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
t: שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין יַלְבֵּשִׁנּוּן כַּהֲנָא תְּחוֹתוֹהִי מִבְּנוֹהִי
דִּי יֵעוֹל לְמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא לְשַׁמָּשָׁא בְקוּדְשָׁא:
e: Seven [consecutive] days shall they be worn by he who serves in his place — one of his sons —
who will come into the Tent of Meeting to serve in the Holy [Sanctuary].
Take the [remainder of the] ram of the completion-offering [offering]
and cook its flesh in a sacred place.

t: וְיֵכוּל אַהֲרֹן וּבְנוֹהִי יָת בְּסַר דִּכְרָא
e: Aharon and his sons shall eat the ram’s meat,
along with the bread that is in the basket,
at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

t: וְחִלּוֹנַי לָא יֵיכוּל אֲרֵי קוּדְשָׁא אִנּוּן:
e: They are to eat those things through which atonement was achieved,
to install them [offer their sacrifices] and [thereby] to sanctify them.
A stranger [a non-kohein] may not eat thereof for they are sacred.

t: וְאִם יִשְׁתָּאַר מִבְּסַר קֻרְבָּנַיָּא וּמִן לַחְמָא עַד צַפְרָא
e: If any meat of the installation-offering [offering] is left over or if any of the bread [is left over] until morning,
you must burn the leftovers in fire.
It must not be eaten for it is sacred.
So shall you do for Aharon and his sons,
according to all that I have commanded you.
Seven days shall you install them [offer their sacrifices].

t: וְתוֹרָא דְחַטָּאתָא תַּעְבֵּד לְיוֹמָא עַל כִּפּוּרַיָּא
e: Offer a bull for a sin-offering each day for atonement;
and by sprinkling [its blood] on the altar you will purify [elevate] it [the altar.]
You shall then anoint it to sanctify it.
For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar
and sanctify it
and thus the altar will be Holy of Holies.
Anything that touches the altar becomes sacred.

t: אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא תְּרֵין לְיוֹמָא תְּדִירָא:
e: And this is what you shall offer upon the altar:
two yearling lambs each day, continually.
Offer one lamb in the morning
and offer the second lamb
in the afternoon.

h: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּשֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַהִ֔ין
t: וְעִסְרוֹנָא סֻלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח כָּתִישָׁא רַבְעוּת הִינָא
e: And a tenth [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of pressed olive oil,
and a libation of a fourth of a hin of wine
for the first lamb.
Offer the second lamb
in the afternoon.
As the meal-offering of the morning together with its libation, shall you offer it,
for a pleasing fragrance [to be accepted with favor],
a fire-offering to [sacrifice before] Adonoy.
This shall be a continual burnt-offering for your generations.
[It shall be offered] at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, before Adonoy,
where I will meet [prepare My Word] with you,
to speak to you there.
It is there that I will meet [prepare My Word] with the B’nei Yisrael,
and it [I] will be sanctified with My Glory.

t: וֶאֱקַדֵּשׁ יָת מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא וְיָת מַדְבְּחָא
וְיָת אַהֲרֹן וְיָת בְּנוֹהִי אֱקַדֵּשׁ לְשַׁמָּשָׁא קֳדָמַי:
e: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar,
and Aharon and his sons I will sanctify to serve [before] Me as kohanim.
I will dwell [rest My Shechina] among the B’nei Yisrael,
and I will be their God.

h: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֧אתִי אֹתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְשָׁכְנִ֣י בְתוֹכָ֑ם
t: דִּי אַפֵּקִית יָתְהוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם לְאַשְׁרָאָה שְׁכִנְתִּי בֵּינֵיהוֹן
e: They will know that I, Adonoy, am their God
who brought them out of the land of Egypt to dwell [rest My Shechina] among them.
I am Adonoy, their God.
You shall make an altar [upon which] to burn incense [spices].
Make it out of Acacia wood.

h: אַמָּ֨ה אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה
t: אַמְּתָא אֻרְכֵּיהּ וְאַמְּתָא פְתָיֵהּ מְרַבַּע יְהֵי
e: It shall be one amoh long and one amoh wide, it shall be a square,
and two amohs high.
Its horn-like elevations shall be of one piece with it.

h: וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו
t: וְתַחֲפֵי יָתֵיהּ דְּהַב דְּכֵי יָת אִגָּרֵיהּ וְיָת כָּתְלוֹהִי סְחוֹר סְחוֹר וְיָת קַרְנוֹהִי
וְתַעְבֵּד לֵיהּ דֵּיר דִּדְהַב סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
e: You shall overlay it with pure gold, on its top, its walls all around, and its horn-like elevations,
and make a gold crown-like rim all around it.

h: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לּ֣וֹ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו
t: וְתַרְתֵּין עִזְקַן דִּדְהַב תַּעְבֵּד לֵיהּ מִלְּרַע לְדֵירֵיהּ עַל תַּרְתֵּין זִוְיָתֵיהּ
e: Make two gold rings for it under its crown-like rim, on two of its corners.
Make them on its two opposite sides.
They will house the poles
with which it is carried.
Make the poles out of acacia wood
and overlay them with gold.
Place it in front of the paroches
that is by the Ark of the Testimony,
in front of the covering that is on the Testimony
where I will meet [prepare My Word] with you there.

t: בִּצְפַר בִּצְפַר בְּאַתְקָנוּתֵיהּ יָת בּוֹצִינַיָּא יַסֵּקִנַּהּ:
e: Aharon shall burn upon it incense of spices.
Every morning when he cleans the lamps, he shall burn it.

h: וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעֲרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה
t: וּבְאַדְלָקוּת אַהֲרֹן יָת בּוֹצִינַיָּא בֵּין שִׁמְשַׁיָּא יַסֵּקִנַּהּ
e: And when Aharon lights the lamps in the afternoon, he shall burn it.
It is a continual incense [spice]-offering before Adonoy for you generations.

h: לֹא־תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה
t: לָא תַסְּקוּן עֲלוֹהִי קְטֹרֶת בּוּסְמִין נוּכְרָאִין וַעֲלָתָא וּמִנְחָתָא
e: Do not bring upon it strange [unauthorized] incense [spices]; neither burnt-offerings nor meal-offerings.
You shall not pour a libation-offering upon it.

h: מִדַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּשָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם
t: מִדְּמָא חַטַּאת כִּפּוּרַיָּא חֲדָא בְשַׁתָּא יְכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי לְדָרֵיכוֹן
e: Aharon shall make atonement on its horn-like elevations
once each year.
With the blood of the sin-offering of atonement, he shall make atonement on it once each year for your generations.
It is Holy of Holies to [before] Adonoy.
